encounters.title: The Warm Mirage
encounters.description: A street musician plays a melody that sounds exactly like a memory you never lived. The crowd smiles in unison.

choices.label: Smile and applaud the melody (Empathy DC 10)
choices.success_text: The Prism rewards your gentleness with a clear Echo Shard, though Mira watches you with a quiet, testing gaze.
choices.failure_text: Your applause rings slightly hollow; the crowd's smiles flicker for a heartbeat.

choices.label: Listen for the dissonance beneath the chords (Perception DC 12)
choices.success_text: Beneath the major key, a low gravitational hum vibrates in the cobblestones. You glimpse the Veil's true depth.
choices.failure_text: The warmth overwhelms your focus, leaving only a faint ache behind your eyes.

encounters.title: The Unblinking Cloister
encounters.description: Three prayer mirrors line the white archway. As the Stilling Bell tolls, one mirror shows an iron confessional instead of your face.

choices.label: Hold the mirror's gaze without flinching (Resolve DC 13)
choices.success_text: Hairline cracks bloom across the silver glass, revealing a hidden latch to the Covenant confessional.
choices.failure_text: You look away as the bell rings sharp; the reflection snaps back to serene white stone.

choices.label: Hum in resonance with the Stilling Bell (Veil Attunement DC 12)
choices.success_text: The bell answers with a warm overtone, granting you clarity without shattering the sanctuary.
choices.failure_text: The harmonic slips, shaking loose a brief storm ripple.

encounters.title: The Weight of Being Known
encounters.description: The Dark Quasar's gravity surges across Obsidian Reach. Every unspoken doubt you carry rises like iron filings toward the sky.

choices.label: Name your doubt aloud and stand firm (Clarity DC 15)
choices.success_text: The gravity does not crush you—it anchors you. The Quasar recognizes earned trust.
choices.failure_text: Suspicion spikes through your bonds as the membrane strains, yet you survive with a sharper eye.
